text:
elaine (marketing): Quick sync 10: we've got a spike in inbound handoff latency this week - FastPass leads waiting >45s before assignment. Can we define a short-term SLA + fallback?

sam (revops): Saw it Friday. Root cause looks like third-party enrichment timeouts. HubSpot flow currently blocks RR until enrichment returns.

martin (eng): Can you share counts by failure mode? I can check traces and a small code change if needed.

sam (revops): Ran a quick pull: timeouts dominate (~412), 5xx (~71), slow success (~14).

anya (eng-plat): Currently intake is intentionally sync-wait for enrichment so SF has enriched props on create. That tradeoff is causing assignment stalls under load.

elaine (marketing): For upcoming launch traffic, proposal: acceptance SLA 30s, fallback to a lightweight enrichment after 15s (tag as "lite-enrich"), then backfill full enrichment async. Keeps SDRs working while we preserve data integrity later.

martin (eng): Implementation idea: intake config -> wait_for_enrich_ms=15000, fallback=lite-enrich, acceptance_deadline_ms=30000, post_accept_backfill=true. Minimal mapping changes.

sam (revops): Important: map a HubSpot property `enrich_quality` (none|partial|full) so SDR filters can treat low-quality leads appropriately. Also ensure we don't auto-unassign high-intent leads. Maybe add a `force_claim` flag for certain score thresholds.

anya (eng-plat): We can add `enrich_quality` and `freshness_flag`. Default RR still assigns; SDR playbook can filter. We'll emit metrics for fallback and backfill.

revops-bot: Alert 2026-03-22T09:12:33Z - lead_unassigned_threshold breached (60s) - 412 events in last 24h.

martin (eng): Plan: flip wait_for_enrich to 15s in staging, canary 5% in prod. If stable, ramp 5%->50%->100% with guards. Rollback command ready.

elaine (marketing): Agree. Rollout guard: if unassigned_rate drops, ramp up; rollback if assign_latency increases. Target: canary today, full rollout by EOD tomorrow if stable. I'll prep comms to SDRs about `lite-enrich`.

sam (revops): I'll update HubSpot mappings and a quick script to auto-tag high-intent leads even if enrichment partial. Also track `percent_assigned_with_full_enrich_within_1h`.

anya (eng-plat): I'll add Console dashboard panels: assign_latency_p50/p95, fallback_rate, backfill_success_rate_1h. Alert if backfill_success_rate_1h < 80%.

martin (eng): Canary deployed to 5% -> initial metrics (10m): assign_latency_p95 from 82s -> 26s, fallback_rate ~5%, backfill queue ~367.

elaine (marketing): Great. Keep updates here. If green at noon PT, proceed with ramp. :thumbsup:

sam (revops): Noted. I'll coordinate SDR playbook update & ping when 50% ramp starts.

martin (eng): Rollback cmd if needed: `routectl set hubspot-intake wait_for_enrich_ms=120000 && routectl set hubspot-intake fallback=null`.
